editorial: Brazil is too big for any answer other than “it depends”.

We visited in October, which is the dry season (June to November) in the Amazon rainforest, but early spring (September to November) in the southeast, which includes Rio, Sao Paulo, and Iguazu. We had a great time everywhere, so maybe visit then?
If you prefer to skip the Amazon and set up shop in the southeast, then summer (December to February) is a good time too. Or autumn (March to May) if you want to experience the carnival.
Alternatively, if you want to explore the deep trenches of the Amazon, then go during the wet / high-water season (December to May).
